data.raw_text:
At the EDSA@40 Revolution commemoration protest in The Hague, Netherlands, kin of drug war victims Llore Pasco, Sheerah Escudero, and Rise Up coordinator Rubilyn Litao show their real bags, saying they are aware of the altered image that has gone viral. 

Pasco told GMA Integrated News that she wasn’t even aware of the luxury brands until the viral photo circulated on social media. | via Jay-vee Marasigan Pangan/stringer
